notes.title: Dank Ages Lore
notes.content:
Greeting Knights!

Long time no hear. We've been dug deep into the back-end part of the game and most of it isn't particularly interesting for the majority of people as long as they value their sanity.

Those works are still in progress and since we are quite a small indie team they might still take a while.

As the Master once said, "Patience is a virtue of the true Knight. You never know if the heavens haven't planned sudden diarrhoea for your opponent" and we took his words to heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/a8b65034b716699d5c8f22145f7609518cf12e19.png[/img]

We are happy to start sharing an introduction/prequel to the Knights & Outlaws story as... it appeared we simply can't hold our horses and going full Mel Brooks and Monthy Python on it... sorry... it will be either gloriously good or hilariously bad, maybe both.

From now on Devlogs will appear as some sort of fable. Please tell us how terrible it is as Syr Christopher collects hate comments to sew tapestries. We will share stuff from the game somewhere along the lines.

Without further ado, let's dive into Dank Ages/Memdieval Times. Expect nothing and take a good pint of ale as the bard has started his tale...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/8521bbdcec4415fe605bff5cb0543f46b350df12.png[/img]

Not so long ago, in a kingdom unknown to the civilized world, there was a village, a hole in the ass-end of the universe. Good people lived there and the turnips they farmed were the best in the region. Market day contributed greatly to the folks' bliss.

The people were singing, and also they danced or at least they tried. A new sound joined the joyful cacophony when with the horses also came the knights. The trumpets were playing, and the Herald was shouting, and He passed the announcements of the King’s decrees. The steel armour gleamed, and the warriors continued to make noise with their instruments, oblivious to the holes in the road making their instruments sound like a kind of a duck with a lung infection.
[i]
"The King of the Realm, the Conqueror of Enemies, the Protector of People, The Very Important Person, the Greatest Sword Owner, the Prodigy, The Husband of the Queen, The Finest Stall..."[/i]

"TO THE POINT WE ARE OVER HOURS NOW"

[i]"...Announces! To celebrate the name day of the third favourite pony of the queen, a Great Knightly Tournament will happen! Royal couple invites all..."[/i]

[i]"Another tournament? The previous one was last week!"[/i]

[i]"...Brave warriors to participate in the biggest, longest, most wonderful tournament ever organized..."

"Last one was the greatest ever as well!"

"And to properly represent the greatness of our Kingdom we would like to ask you to like and subscri..."[/i]

The first turnip flew just next to the Herald's ear. If he noticed it, he did not show himself.

[i]"...and DONATE to support the magnificent mission of growing the popularity of our national sport!"[/i]

The second turnip went for the head, and the Herald dodged it effortlessly. The crowd became slightly confused, the thrower was John, son of John, and he never misses even if he made roundhouse kick first.
The mob was up to challenge. More turnips flew towards the Herald, but he just stood there dodging all the projectiles with both shoes, never leaving the ground like he had some sort of instinct... Whatever he said after it drowns in voices of people enjoying new entertainment.
Soon knights came forward, raised their shields and started singing about the greatness of local blacksmith skills and quality. No turnip hit Herald this day.

The wrinkles of the knight sitting in a nearby garden of the nearby tavern deepened when a smile appeared on his face. Single grey hairs gleamed in the sun as he put down his mug.
"Boy. Prepare the horse. If the kingdom calls, the knight must respond. And whoever fulfils their duties will be rewarded..."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/c7d2c5b4a6410f46f9053d61796bc1b00b36863e.png[/img]

More is coming soon. Join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/kYpZmkBAgc]Discord Server![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #11 Inventory, Items and Item Actions.
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Knights![/h1]

Recently we were busy with back-end stuff inside Unity Engine. We are almost done with our own Inventory plugin that is customized for Knight Simulator needs and very flexible. Today let's have some insight into the Unity Engine itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/bbaaaa891edcfb2693e2fc8060b4f354ae1a0411.png[/img]
Item Editor allows us to add new items. Allows us to set the item display name, description and 3D model that corresponds to this item. Each item can have a Buff or Debuff assigned to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/d9416a329fe1714ea8cc58502066b64e1a18bd4f.png[/img]
Buff Editor is a tool that we created to manage the balance of items. From this view, we can easily adjust overpowered or underpowered stuff. We can set here, for example, that the Steel Sword has more attack and a negative agility value than the Iron Sword.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/143f18dbc6a640585b755913f4bd073008a0224b.png[/img]
Inventory Editor is only used to display the list of items that the player has in their inventory. We did not develop this window that we do not need it that much but it will be very handy for future bug-fixing and testing.

Everything here might look like a typical RPG setup, but we're working on another window that manages and calculates the stats to make gameplay and combat fun and fairly realistic. This is just our back-end insight into item statistics. In-game inventory is still WIP from an aesthetic point of view so we will share it later.

More content in future Devlogs. Feedback is welcome, so leave a comment or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/kYpZmkBAgc]Discord Server![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #10 - Combat System part 1.
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Knights![/h1]

We are currently working on our Combat System, World Design and a lot of back-end stuff development, sometimes called invisible upgrades. Today we will talk about Combat System in our game.
 
It went through several iterations and changes, but we believe we are on the right path now. 

Currently, we implemented the basics of the system. The game appropriately reacts to commands, and when it hit enemies, they are receiving damage and dying. It works for enemies connecting their weapons to our Knight as well.

We have an intriguing idea for our Combat System to stand out from other, similar games, but we need to connect several mechanics first, and that is a work in progress for now. Sadly there are only a few ways to make FPP melee combat in a game, so at first, ours might reassemble one from the Mount and Blade, or Kingdom Come: Deliverance series, but it's because we didn't implement everything yet. 
Some similarities are inevitable, though.

Overall it will be slower and more tactical than MnB, with several extra twists. We don't really want to overcomplicate it KC:D way, neither (but we think it is a great Combat System!). 
We will share more about it when it is ready. 

[b]The basics of combat are simple and based on four directions of attack.[/b]
[previewyoutube=nydLDyRYWgU;full][/previewyoutube][i]Attack animations are placeholders and will be changed. The system behind it works great so far.[/i]

The player can choose attack and defence directions both by mouse and keyboard depending on the Player choice.

[b]Defence follows the same rules, see shield example below.[/b]
[previewyoutube=3WTbATXpo8E;full][/previewyoutube]Again animations will change soon. For now, we are focused on a good working back-end of combat.

Despise the popular theory of Knights being slow in their heavy armours. We know it wasn't a matter. Well trained knight was much quicker and nimbler than most unarmoured but untrained people. 
In our game, knights will be able to side-step/dodge.
[previewyoutube=ZwyHwbXabwY;full][/previewyoutube][i]We will limit this with some sort of Stamina system.[/i]

We also implemented an enemy targeting system. It's not necessary to use but very helpful in various situations. It would be awesome to hear Your opinions about it.
[previewyoutube=PQc7yUyXiqs;full][/previewyoutube][i]Fun fact, enemies are running away on low health[/i]

Slowly but steadily, we are closing to the promised graphical quality of the game. Animations need a lot of work, and we will share progress in future Devlogs. We are pretty happy with our World Design so far. 

We are also constantly testing and bug-fixing the game. Below You might check our recently killed bug. We found it hilarious, so we would like to share it. There is a sample of game soundtrack as a bonus :)

More content in future Devlogs. Feedback is welcome, so leave the comment or join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/GTyR9ZC]Discord Server![/url]

notes.title: Devlog #8 - Lockpicking
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Knights![/h1]

Usually when we think - Knight - we have a vision of a brave warrior charging through the battlefield. However, knights had quite a wide spectrum of duties like governing and protecting lands but also... being an interesting person to carry around during feasts! Or simpler - diplomats and spies...

Overall a good Knight is a person useful to his Senior. And to be useful one poor knight may need a particular set of skills like... [b]LOCKPICKING[/b]

[previewyoutube=dtpqhKpp-pg;full][/previewyoutube]

Lockpicking may come very handy in some situations but overall we consider it a minor mechanic so we want to keep it simple and fun. 

We are working to improve its visuals (like adding a door background behind the lock), improve how hints are looking, and balance the difficulty. 

Be careful sniffing around! Getting caught will negatively affect both Your reputation and pouch!

Every feedback is welcome so we would like to invite You to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/GTyR9ZC]Discord Server![/url]
Your Knight Simulator Team

notes.title: DevLog#4
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone!
[/h2]
We are very motivated by how much this project is developing day by day. We have added many new elements such as houses, home furnishings, doors, loading screen .. and a new UI will be added soon. The look of the game is changing drastically and we think it's for good! It took us a lot to fine-tune some elements, such as water - it is really difficult to work to make it look seriously realistic! Or the sky and the light, you have to really think hard to make it look realistic and consistent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/77b1c138f347479ebe77538575b07a69c790b108.jpg[/img]

[h3]Well, but what's up with this flag? So this is May 1 in Poland.[/h3]
It is "Work Day", so you have a free day from your work. It sounds funny, but it's really true. When we were children, it often looked like we didn't have to go to school and then we could sit at home and make some small pc games.

You will ask – why we write about May 1st and put it on May 3rd. Well – it was a day off. 

Btw. Today it’s May 3d - the anniversary of the enactment of the Constitution. One of the most important anniversary in Poland. 

Knights fought for centuries to have the document of rights like that... sadly none of them survived to see this as it was done in 1791.

notes.title: DevLog#3
notes.content:
We are playing the next version of the game! The game is slowly taking on interesting shapes! The world around the hero is beautiful and realistic, the stronghold - like taken out of the past - probably existed somewhere in the Middle Ages! A small dungeon is being built under the castle walls. It has the atmosphere of knightly facilities ... there are places where we can raise our hero to a higher level or get tasks.

Three new and important places! Blacksmith's house, shop and witch's hut, where we will improve the parameters for the right amount of gold or other activities. These are very interesting places, hidden in the village under the castle, in addition, you can see these three characters in their daily work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/fcdbfe578b580ca32e19e82323e12b2274ec1f62.jpg[/img]

The castle has gained a few new chambers, a few secret basements, but it will still be more developed in the next stages of work on the game. You can sometimes feel like in classic dungeons. We will also meet a witch there, whom we will secretly help.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/ff5b763735201659322ce4bb1125601a7cc92aae.jpg[/img]

The main character has been developed, its visual appearance has been improved, we now see hands, a shield that can be defended and charged at enemies! In addition, the whole area as if it became lush, richer ... beautiful grasses, bushes, water reservoirs, bridges ... Moving around in this large world is a joy!

Link to the clip: https://twitter.com/GamingFactory6/status/1246127921691070465

The most interesting element that has been added is ... Village defense! Briefly saying that the villagers are asking us for help in the fight against bandits. We, as a good knight, must drive out or kill the bandits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/3ece4bc1bab70628589903745c9ad8e7bf1888e8.jpg[/img]

From the technical side. We've improved the overall rendering of the world, and we're still working on good lighting. We also plan to divide locations into separate levels. For example, entering the castle will load its only content of the castle so as not to take too much computer resources. Same with other buildings and huts. We are still improving the character's movement so that you can feel realism.
We also had to buy more RAM for our computers, because not enough, slowed down our work. From now on, we can work on our game even faster and more accurately. It has already been of great use to us when burning lights that are still in-progress.
In the next stage of work, we will expand the stronghold with new places, enrich the area with details, and another interesting thing will be introduced: knight tournaments! We will add and improve new missions, dialogues and, as every month, we will introduce corrections and new comments from our testers.


Take care of yourself and #stayhome!

notes.title: DevLog#2
notes.content:
Playing the latest version of the game, I'll say boldly: a lot of new things have been changed or added! Everything you know i.e. buildings of the castle, walls and rocks, nooks and crannies with beer barrels - all of these are being built from the scratch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/6d1f56d6412c232e1f3aa9757826853d7e81a921.gif[/img]

The castle has gained a tangible size... when you look at it from a bird's eye view, gliding in a circling motion over the hill, you can see the vastness of the place, truly medieval features of the walls, villages around the fortress, here and there clumps of forest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/dee31d1bb52e55539c4706467d08a0c59c2753a6.jpg[/img]

The area given for exploration is quite massive. The castle itself has a layout close to historical realities, a large courtyard, the main gate to which the road leads through the elevation. The interiors are: large chambers, stone and wooden stairs in many places, many corridors to smaller and side dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/d878e6e58954441f1f6ac26f8f499c8885ec1c9c.jpg[/img]

We can already run, crouch... have conversations, collect items for a lot of equipment and fight! In the current version, we can kill a knight who is spinning near the main gate. It's super impressive to drop your opponent from the stairs, escape, attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35443403/e8791263477944c61b15c3c4a4e3b0e3cc5ed129.jpg[/img]

At the moment we are making numerous optical corrections - visual, repairing minor technical shortcomings of the movement, introducing a new interaction: a shopkeeper, smith and magician. At the first one we will buy better knight's equipment with coins, at the blacksmith's we will raise our weapons to a higher level, at the magician's we will develop our magic branch. 

This game will be firmly rooted in the realities of the Middle Ages, but it will also have a taste of alchemy, spells, all the mystery into which those dark and unusual times were buried.

notes.title: DevLog#1
notes.content:
Welcome!
We would like to share with you some fresh information about the Knight Simulator project.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sfGLIxk.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/S7ziAsM.png[/img]
The action takes place in an extensive castle on the rocks, located in an interesting area in the mountains. Wandering the main courtyard or in the currently modeled chambers is an experience. [img]https://i.imgur.com/p8BhYGr.png[/img]Varied terrain, lots of stairs, recesses and secret corridors, caves, hidden chambers and passage from the mountains to the villages. The time with which the knight's adepts his skills is picturesque - it's snowing, the pavement begins to whiten ... joyful sky - nothing but developing an arsenal of battle and magic in favorable weather!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DhQDbJC.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Elrb4pg.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/t40GOA4.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/907xDVz.png[/img]
Well, let’s talk about the mechanics.
We've been thinking about our game lately in terms of gameplay itself and decided to add some more magic to it. However, it will not be easy to use. To use magic potions, you'll need to find the ingredients for making the potion at the witch's place.
We already have:
• Movement of the character
• Attacking
• Some UI elements
• Talking to the NPC
• A pretty large part of the map
• Good graphics render

We are currently working on:
• Equipment, pick-ups, equipping or using items
• Tutorial
• Addons to the character movement
• Addons to the interaction with the NPCs
• We are expanding and modeling the kingdom and everything else
You are probably also curious about what we will add later? We will add enemies! Yes, we will be able to duel with enemies and gain loot. We will also add the ability to reflect new elements and areas of the world. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9xIDIKA.jpg[/img]
Our tester tested the project on a few machines and we can already say that it will be hard to play on a PC with 4GB of RAM, but we will do our best so that users with older PCs can also play without problems!


Stay Royal,
DevTeam@CLIMOU
